method: Each listed item was read with its stem, all options, keyed answer(s), explanations and takeaway. Statuses are manually reasoned, not inferred from a schema or automated pass rule.
limitations: Independent AI editorial/clinical-reasoning screen; not external clinician validation or psychometric validation.
Pass applies only to the recorded content hash. New or changed content requires further review.
No comparison against proprietary examination items; originality judged from author provenance and item content.
Cross-bank learning-objective overlap remains provisional until all batches are available.
Source checks below support only the explicitly associated claims; other category references are general reading unless specifically verified.

items.assessment: A rehearsed cue explicitly in the therapy plan is appropriate during balanced assisted freezing; pulling, rushing and competing instructions can destabilize. Individualized plan prevents an unsupported universal cue prescription.

Observed better-movement period is a relevant cue for scheduling nonurgent bathing; fixed timing or extra attempts during poor function misses a practical adaptation. No medication timing is independently changed.

Removing the prosthesis to assess the wrinkle-related pressure area addresses a specific mechanical source; leaving fit unchanged or adding bulk does not. Further prosthesis fitting remains individualized.

referenceFinding: c-mobility is a transferring/ambulation chapter. It supports general functional assistance but cannot substantiate unrelated reflux, mucositis, taste, ostomy, intake or communication claims. Individualized supplied therapy plans limit unsupported generalization for the passed mobility applications.
